Learn moreOnline multiplayer on console requires XBOX Game Pass Essential, Premium, or Ultimate (subscriptions sold separately).DETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionSonic dashes into the world of the hit indie game, PICO PARK! Experience the multiplayer co-op action puzzle gameplay of the PICO PARK series like never before! In our latest entry, the PICO PARK series is teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! SONIC PICO PARK is a 2D action puzzle game where cooperation is essential! The rules are simple: just reach the goal plate on the right side of each stage. But the only way to succeed is for everyone to work together. This exciting crossover lets every playable character use Sonic's iconic Spin Dash, while adding classic Sonic-style gameplay elements such as rings, loops, and springs! Team up with your friends and take on these new challenges together! Just like the rest of the series, the game supports 2 to 8 players locally or online. All content can be enjoyed with any number of players! Online play also supports cross-play! Combining the flair of Sonic and the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK, this one-of-a-kind collaboration is packed with fun for everyone... whether you experience it with family, friends, your partner, or even new teammates you meet online! Gather your squad and try it today!Show morePublished byPICO PARK Inc.Developed byTECOPARKRelease date11/12/2026Play withXBOX OneXBOX Series X|SPCHandheldCapabilitiesXbox local co-op (2-8)Online co-op (2-8)Xbox local multiplayer (2-8)Online multiplayer (2-8)Xbox cross-platform multiplayerXbox cross-platform co-op60 fps+Xbox achievementsXbox Play Anywhere XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

source.title: Pikmin™ 4 - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 6Comic Mischief, Fantasy ViolenceGamesPikmin™ 4 - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori AcademyReleases 11/12/26Select a versionNintendo Switch 2Nintendo SwitchUpgrade PackWhat's an upgrade pack?Select an editionPhysical - Pikmin™ 4 - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition + Dandori AcademyComic Mischief, Fantasy ViolenceQuantity1LoadingFind retailersNintendo Switch 2 features• Enhance your expedition with improved visuals for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system.• Sharpen your command of Pikmin in a series of exams at Dandori Academy.• Give voice commands to Oatchi, your dependable space dog, using the Nintendo Switch 2 system microphone.• Challenge your friends in Dandori Battles, even if they don’t have the game, via GameShare** locally or online via GameChat.Guide plantlike Pikmin on an enhanced expedition!Meet Pikmin: small, plantlike creatures you can grow, pluck, guide, and send into battle with creatures multiple times their size! These loyal, curious helpers come in different types, including fire-resistant Red Pikmin, Ice Pikmin that can freeze bodies of water, and Glow Pikmin that can light the way forward at night. The fate of your Pikmin is yours to decide!Create and customize your own pint-sized explorer and traverse a world that is teeming with life—and visually enhanced with high-resolution graphics for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 system!Enroll at Dandori AcademyDandori is the art of commanding your Pikmin effectively, and sometimes explorers like to get in on some friendly competition. The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of the game features Dandori Academy*, an extensive series of Dandori exam stages for you to test your skill and earn in-game medals! A total of 72 stages will be released over time—and they vary in difficulty, so you can choose the ones that match your skill level.Battle with your budsWhen you’re ready to take on your fellow explorers in Dandori Battles, you can do so with a friend on the same system†. You can even get them in on the fun via GameShare‡ locally or online via GameChat—even if they don’t have the game!Who’s an even gooder boy?!Dependable partner Oatchi has learned a new trick: he can now listen for your voice commands via the Nintendo Switch 2 system microphone as you play! (Don’t be shy about telling him how good he is.)Enjoy enhanced visualsDelight in sharper detail with improved high-resolution visuals in both TV mode and handheld mode.Experience it all on Nintendo Switch 2This game is the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. It includes the Nintendo Switch game plus the upgrade pack, which adds more features and enhancements for play on Nintendo Switch 2.Get the full gameAlready have the Pikmin 4 game?Get just the upgrade pack to enhance your game for play on Nintendo Switch 2!Get the upgrade pack* Full version of the Pikmin 4 game required to use this content. Sold separately. For details, visit support.nintendo.com/switch2/upgradepack† Additional games, systems and/or accessories may be required for multiplayer mode. Games, systems and some accessories sold separately.‡ Nintendo Switch 2 system must initiate GameShare session. Users who receive software via GameShare can only play the software during the session in which it was shared. Shared game will not be playable after the session ends. Nintendo Switch 2 and GameChat required for each user engaging in GameShare via GameChat. Internet, Nintendo Switch Online membership (sold separately) and Nintendo Account required for online features, including GameChat. Not available in all countries. Terms and GameChat requirements apply. support.nintendo.com© NintendoPublisher notification(s):Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy Coming SoonYou can start playing the Nintendo Switch version today and be ready to play the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition at launch by pre-ordering the upgrade pack***.About this itemSupported play modesHandheld modeTV modeTabletop modeNo. of playersSingle system (1-2)Local wireless (2)Online (2)Nintendo Switch OnlineSave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
